title: Ledger
description: The line items behind a figure: pick a month or period and filters, or arrive by clicking a figure on another dashboard.

list.name: month
list.label: Month
list.description: The month shown, or the month the period counts back from.
list.query: select to_char(month_start, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as __value, to_char(month_start, 'Mon YYYY') as __text from marts.fct_month_plan order by month_start desc
list.definition: select to_char(month_start, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as __value, to_char(month_start, 'Mon YYYY') as __text from marts.fct_month_plan order by month_start desc

list.name: span
list.label: Period
list.description: The month itself, or the full months before it.
list.query: This month : 0,The 3 full months before it : 3,The 6 full months before it : 6,The 12 full months before it : 12

list.name: category
list.label: Category
list.query: select v as __value, t as __text from (select 'all' as v, 'All' as t, 0 as o union all select distinct category_name, category_name, 1 from marts.fct_subcategory_month) x order by o, t
list.definition: select v as __value, t as __text from (select 'all' as v, 'All' as t, 0 as o union all select distinct category_name, category_name, 1 from marts.fct_subcategory_month) x order by o, t

list.name: paid
list.label: Paid by
list.description: Whose money paid. The other dashboards count only what you paid.

list.name: tag
list.label: Tag
list.query: select v as __value, t as __text from (select 'all' as v, 'All' as t, 0 as o union all select distinct u.tag, u.tag, 1 from marts.fct_transactions f cross join lateral unnest(f.tags) as u (tag)) x order by o, t
list.definition: select v as __value, t as __text from (select 'all' as v, 'All' as t, 0 as o union all select distinct u.tag, u.tag, 1 from marts.fct_transactions f cross join lateral unnest(f.tags) as u (tag)) x order by o, t

list.name: q
list.label: Search
list.description: Text to find in the item, merchant or note.

panels.title: This selection
panels.description: Spending for the month or period and the filters chosen at the top. 'Paid by' starts on you, which is what the other dashboards count.

targets.rawSql:
select coalesce(sum(amount), 0) as "Spent", coalesce(sum(amount), 0) / greatest(${span}, 1) as "Per month", count(*) as "Line items"
from marts.fct_transactions
where type = 'expense'
  and month_start >= '${month}'::date - make_interval(months => ${span})
  and month_start < '${month}'::date + case when ${span} = 0 then interval '1 month' else interval '0' end
  and ('${bucket}' = 'all' or initcap(bucket) = '${bucket}')
  and (${category:sqlstring} = 'all' or category_name = ${category:sqlstring})
  and ('${paid}' = 'all' or is_self_funded = ('${paid}' = 'own'))
  and (${tag:sqlstring} = 'all' or ${tag:sqlstring} = any(tags))
  and (${q:sqlstring} = '' or concat_ws(' ', item_description, description, merchant_name, venue_name, notes) ilike '%' || ${q:sqlstring} || '%')

panels.title: By subcategory
panels.description: Each subcategory in the selection, largest first. Per month divides by the number of months in the period; typical is the median line item.

targets.rawSql:
select
  category_name as "Category",
  subcategory_name as "Subcategory",
  initcap(bucket) as "Bucket",
  sum(amount) as "Spent",
  sum(amount) / greatest(${span}, 1) as "Per month",
  count(*) as "Line items",
  percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by amount) as "Typical"
from marts.fct_transactions
where type = 'expense'
  and month_start >= '${month}'::date - make_interval(months => ${span})
  and month_start < '${month}'::date + case when ${span} = 0 then interval '1 month' else interval '0' end
  and ('${bucket}' = 'all' or initcap(bucket) = '${bucket}')
  and (${category:sqlstring} = 'all' or category_name = ${category:sqlstring})
  and ('${paid}' = 'all' or is_self_funded = ('${paid}' = 'own'))
  and (${tag:sqlstring} = 'all' or ${tag:sqlstring} = any(tags))
  and (${q:sqlstring} = '' or concat_ws(' ', item_description, description, merchant_name, venue_name, notes) ilike '%' || ${q:sqlstring} || '%')
group by 1, 2, 3
order by 4 desc, 1, 2

panels.title: Selection by month
panels.description: Spending that matches the filters at the top for each of the last 12 full months and this month, whatever period is selected. It shows whether a figure is a one-off or a habit. * marks this month so far.

targets.rawSql:
select
  to_char(p.month_start, 'Mon YY') || case when p.is_complete_month then '' else '*' end as month,
  coalesce(sum(f.amount), 0) as "Spent"
from (select * from marts.fct_month_plan order by month_start desc limit 13) p
left join (
  select month_start, amount from marts.fct_transactions
  where type = 'expense'
    and ('${bucket}' = 'all' or initcap(bucket) = '${bucket}')
  and (${category:sqlstring} = 'all' or category_name = ${category:sqlstring})
  and ('${paid}' = 'all' or is_self_funded = ('${paid}' = 'own'))
  and (${tag:sqlstring} = 'all' or ${tag:sqlstring} = any(tags))
  and (${q:sqlstring} = '' or concat_ws(' ', item_description, description, merchant_name, venue_name, notes) ilike '%' || ${q:sqlstring} || '%')
) f on f.month_start = p.month_start
group by p.month_start, p.is_complete_month
order by p.month_start

panels.title: Line items
panels.description: Every line in the selection, largest first. Use the funnel on a column header to narrow further, for example to one subcategory.

targets.rawSql:
select
  to_char(occurred_on, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as "Date",
  coalesce(item_description, description) as "Item",
  coalesce(merchant_name, venue_name) as "Merchant",
  category_name as "Category",
  subcategory_name as "Subcategory",
  initcap(bucket) as "Bucket",
  amount as "Amount",
  array_to_string(tags, ', ') as "Tags",
  funding_source_name as "Paid by",
  notes as "Note"
from marts.fct_transactions
where type = 'expense'
  and month_start >= '${month}'::date - make_interval(months => ${span})
  and month_start < '${month}'::date + case when ${span} = 0 then interval '1 month' else interval '0' end
  and ('${bucket}' = 'all' or initcap(bucket) = '${bucket}')
  and (${category:sqlstring} = 'all' or category_name = ${category:sqlstring})
  and ('${paid}' = 'all' or is_self_funded = ('${paid}' = 'own'))
  and (${tag:sqlstring} = 'all' or ${tag:sqlstring} = any(tags))
  and (${q:sqlstring} = '' or concat_ws(' ', item_description, description, merchant_name, venue_name, notes) ilike '%' || ${q:sqlstring} || '%')
order by amount desc, occurred_on desc, line_key

panels.title: Selection by merchant
panels.description: The selection grouped by merchant, largest first.

targets.rawSql:
select
  coalesce(merchant_name, venue_name, 'No merchant recorded') as "Merchant",
  sum(amount) as "Spent",
  count(distinct transaction_id) as "Purchases"
from marts.fct_transactions
where type = 'expense'
  and month_start >= '${month}'::date - make_interval(months => ${span})
  and month_start < '${month}'::date + case when ${span} = 0 then interval '1 month' else interval '0' end
  and ('${bucket}' = 'all' or initcap(bucket) = '${bucket}')
  and (${category:sqlstring} = 'all' or category_name = ${category:sqlstring})
  and ('${paid}' = 'all' or is_self_funded = ('${paid}' = 'own'))
  and (${tag:sqlstring} = 'all' or ${tag:sqlstring} = any(tags))
  and (${q:sqlstring} = '' or concat_ws(' ', item_description, description, merchant_name, venue_name, notes) ilike '%' || ${q:sqlstring} || '%')
group by 1
order by 2 desc, 1
limit 8

panels.title: Income and transfers
panels.description: Money in, and moves between your accounts, for the month or period at the top. The other filters do not apply here.

targets.rawSql:
select
  to_char(occurred_on, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as "Date",
  initcap(type) as "Type",
  counterparty as "From or to",
  amount as "Amount"
from marts.fct_ledger_entry
where type in ('income', 'transfer')
  and month_start >= '${month}'::date - make_interval(months => ${span})
  and month_start < '${month}'::date + case when ${span} = 0 then interval '1 month' else interval '0' end
order by occurred_on desc, transaction_id
